_comment: dex = SpriteCollab folder under assets/pokemon. Stats are the species' base stats. tier ranks starter candidates (3 = strongest; rerolls remove the top tier). biome places wild spawns (see spawns.json). moves are ids from moves.json (first four are the kit). Tier 4 entries are the demo team (title screen 'Demo Team'); a dex of the form <dex>-shiny loads assets/pokemon/<dex>-shiny (SpriteCollab's 0000/0001 shiny set). heightM/along/coil/bodyPx size the sprite to its Pokédex height next to a trainer; body is measured by scripts/measure_species.py. evolves lists [{to, level}]: the Pokémon evolves on reaching that level (several entries = one picked at random, e.g. Eevee). tier 0 = evolved forms, never rolled.
